title: Sample-Efficient Residual-Adaptive Collocation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Shuttlecock Dynamics Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility package supporting a 270-run comparison of MC-R, LHS-R, and residual-adaptive LHS resampling for a physics-informed neural network applied to nonlinear shuttlecock flipping dynamics. The package contains the statistical supplement, run-level data and experiment metadata, and the frozen Python implementation used for the publication experiment.
